name: Did you consult with business stakeholders when creating the impact assessment?
conditionsText:
Applies whenever:
- An asset evaluation is being completed.
- Business impacts are being scored.
- Security priorities are being established
requirementTitle: Did you consult with business stakeholders when creating the impact assessment?
requirementDescription: Did you involve the people who understand how the service operates and how the organisation would be affected by a security incident?
why:
Technical teams understand systems.
Business stakeholders understand:
- Operational impacts.
- Financial impacts.
- Regulatory consequences.
- Reputational damage.
- User impacts.
The guidance specifically recommends involving asset owners, service owners, security professionals and other business stakeholders when assessing asset importance. Workshops and surveys are recommended methods for gathering this information.
